note: Shared reference material every install ships with. The portal reads this file on install and when updating (src/features/references). Every source works offline from the copy in this repository; a source with `vendored` set is served from that path, and GitHub is only asked (with a short timeout) when checking for a newer version. If GitHub is unreachable nothing changes.

sources.name: Shine CSS
sources.usedFor: Styling of the portal (admin) and the public site. Replaces Tailwind. The public site and customer portal load it from the GitHub release through jsDelivr with an integrity hash (src/features/frontendAssets/builtin.ts); public/vendor/shine is the fallback. The admin still bundles src/styles/shine/shine.css. Admin-only extras live in src/styles/engage-utilities.css (generated by scripts/generate-utilities.mjs).

sources.name: Spark
sources.usedFor: Effects and charts applied with spark- classes. The loader starts only when a page uses a spark- class and is referenced from the v0.4.0 release (same commit as before) with an integrity hash; if the CDN fails, the copy in public/vendor/spark is used.

sources.name: Engage templates
sources.usedFor: Default template library, listed in Templates next to the built-in starters. Can be switched off in Settings > Template libraries.
